summary: Miss Amara is a Sydney rug retailer, bootstrapped by founders Aaron and Alexandra Weller, with Forbes reporting 36% sales growth and staff across Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong and the US. Luke Hatton joined as Financial Controller in September 2025 from Coco Republic.

sources.title: Rugs to riches: How Miss Amara spun a $26m empire from the floor up

hooks.text: Luke moved from Coco Republic to Miss Amara in September 2025; multi-country growth plus pre-order stock funding makes the close complex.
Pre-order model means deposits and stock timing recs.
Bootstrapped, so cash visibility matters directly.

first.subject: Month-end across Miss Amara's four markets
